themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents capable of performing research tasks autonomously, including complex analysis, data gathering, and hypothesis generation.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Covers a broad range of AI-powered tools and platforms designed to assist researchers in various stages of the research process, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Explores AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, and understanding code, often acting as collaborative partners in the development process.

themes.name: AI sentiment & feedback analysis
themes.description: Articles discussing the use of AI to analyze and interpret user sentiment, feedback, and reviews from various sources to gain qualitative insights.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Focuses on how AI is being integrated into product management workflows, including idea generation, prioritization, and market analysis.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Examines the research and development of AI chatbots, including their capabilities, limitations, and impact on user interactions.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Covers the creation and use of AI-generated user personas or data for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI-powered data analysis
themes.description: Highlights the application of AI techniques for analyzing large datasets, identifying patterns, and extracting meaningful insights.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Focuses on AI applications for conducting and analyzing usability tests, aiming to identify design flaws and areas for improvement.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Explores how AI is being used in the design process, from concept generation to prototyping and user interface refinement.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
